nonReversible.LOTO_SETTLEMENT: A Loto settlement is final — if it was wrong, correct the Loto balance with an opposite Add Credit/Debt entry for Loto on the Suppliers page.
nonReversible.REFUND: This row is itself a refund — it can't be refunded or voided again. An admin can undo a per-item refund right from this row ("Undo refund"); other refunds have no undo yet.
nonReversible.REFUND_UNDO: This row already undoes a refund — it can't be refunded, voided, or undone again.
nonReversible.KEPT_CHANGE: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — the kept change stays in the drawer either way. Refund the customer's basket instead; that removes it too.
nonReversible.EXTRA_CHARGE: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — it only records the extra charged at checkout. Void or refund the customer's basket instead; that removes it too.
nonReversible.WAIVED_SHORTFALL: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — it only records the amount waived at checkout. Void or refund the customer's basket instead; that removes it too.
nonReversible.BASKET_DISCOUNT: Nothing to reverse on this row by itself — it only records the discount given at checkout. Void or refund the customer's basket instead; that removes it too.
nonReversible.HOLD_MONEY_COLLECT_VOID: This row already reverses a Hold Money pickup — it can't be reversed again.
nonReversible.CHECKPOINT: Checkpoints are a point-in-time count, not a transaction to undo — correct a bad count with a new checkpoint.
nonReversible.CLIENT_CREATED: This is a client-record audit entry, not a money transaction — there's nothing to refund.
nonReversible.CLIENT_UPDATED: This is a client-record audit entry, not a money transaction — there's nothing to refund.
nonReversible.CLIENT_DELETED: This is a client-record audit entry, not a money transaction — there's nothing to refund.
nonReversible.VOUCHER_CANCEL: A voucher cancel is final — it can't be refunded or voided. Sell a new voucher from the Vouchers page if needed.
nonReversible.MTC_TOPUP: This old customer top-up was recorded before carrier lines were tracked, so its credits can't be taken back automatically — correct the line's credits on the Recharge page.
nonReversible.ALFA_TOPUP: This old customer top-up was recorded before carrier lines were tracked, so its credits can't be taken back automatically — correct the line's credits on the Recharge page.
nonReversible.carrierLineNoValues: This line edit did not record the line's previous credits, so it can't be put back automatically — edit the line again on the Recharge page.

refundModal.subtitleUnitsOnly: A reversal entry will be created. Review the returned phone(s) below, then confirm.

refundModal.subtitleKept: A reversal entry will be created. Choose which drawer(s) the refund is handed back from, and adjust the rate if needed. Hand back what the customer originally paid — in cash or a wallet in {{currency}} it may be short by up to {{cap}}, and the rest is kept as profit.
